This file guides Claude Code for this repository.

**CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.

Commands:
```sh
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
```

**⚠️ IMPORTANT**: The `.claude-plugin/` directory and TypeScript plugin system described in older docs **DO NOT EXIST** in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0 (see [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419)).

**Current v4.1.9 Architecture**: Python package with slash commands: `settings.json`, `commands/`, `src/superclaude/` (`pytest_plugin.py`, `pm_agent/`, `execution/`, `cli/`), `tests/`, `scripts/`, `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`. `plugins/superclaude/` is Future plugin source (**NOT ACTIVE**). Registered via `pyproject.toml` entry point, automatically available after installation.

Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Unit → `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.unit`; integration → `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.integration`; markers: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.confidence_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.self_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.reflexion`.

ConfidenceChecker: ≥90% required, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. SelfCheckProtocol: evidence-based validation; no speculation—verify tests/docs. ReflexionPattern: error learning and cross-session matching. Use **Wave → Checkpoint → Wave** (`src/superclaude/execution/parallel.py`).

**⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED**: The TypeScript plugin system described below does not exist in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0. See [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419) and `docs/plugin-reorg.md`.

Current commands: `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`; install location `~/.claude/commands/`; `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo` (and others).

**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation. Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. Always prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research. MCP: **airis-mcp-gateway**, Tavily, Context7, Sequential, Serena, Mindbase; optional Playwright, Magic, Chrome DevTools.

Branches: `master` ← `integration` ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`.
```sh
git checkout -b feature/your-feature
uv run pytest
git commit -m "feat: description"
```
Merge to `integration` → validate → `master`.

**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```sh
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```
Use separate sessions/directories; no branch conflicts.

Read `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`, and `docs/user-guide/`, `docs/developer-guide/`, `docs/reference/`. Budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500 tokens. Confidence ROI: spend 100-200 to save 5,000-50,000.

```sh
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
```

**What Does NOT Work** (yet):
❌ `.claude-plugin/` directory auto-detection
❌ `/plugin marketplace add` commands
❌ `/plugin install superclaude`
❌ `make build-plugin` (planned but not functional)
❌ Project-local plugin detection

Package: `superclaude`; build system: hatchling (PEP 517); CLI: `superclaude`; pytest plugin: auto-loaded as `superclaude`.
